facts.text: The hotel sits at the junction of Marylebone, Mayfair and Fitzrovia.
facts.excerpt: The Langham, London is uniquely positioned at the junction of Marylebone, Mayfair, and Fitzrovia.

facts.text: Oxford Circus station is about a 5-minute walk from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: The hotel is located just 0.3 miles (approximately a 5-minute walk) from the heart of Oxford Street and the Oxford Circus station.

facts.text: The hotel opened on 10 June 1865 as Europe's first purpose-built grand hotel.
facts.excerpt: The Langham, London officially opened on June 10, 1865

facts.text: At opening the hotel offered electric lights and hydraulic lifts.
facts.excerpt: featuring then-innovative amenities like electric lights and hydraulic lifts

facts.text: On-site venues include Palm Court for afternoon tea, the Artesian cocktail bar, The Wigmore British tavern and Sale e Pepe Mare.
facts.excerpt: Palm Court for afternoon tea, the Artesian cocktail bar, The Wigmore British tavern, and contemporary European cuisine at Sale e Pepe Mare.

facts.text: The Wigmore has emerald walls, parquet floors and its own locally brewed beer.
facts.excerpt: emerald walls, parquet floors, and its own locally brewed beer

facts.text: Guests of Executive Rooms and Suites get complimentary access to The Langham Club.
facts.excerpt: Guests of Executive Rooms and Suites enjoy complimentary access to The Langham Club

facts.text: The Infinity Suite has a semi-circular sitting room and an infinity bath.
facts.excerpt: The Infinity Suite boasts a unique semi-circular sitting room, incredible views, and an irresistible infinity bath.

facts.text: The Sterling Suite is a penthouse suite with a private media lounge.
facts.excerpt: a private media lounge, this penthouse suite

facts.text: The Chuan Body + Soul spa has an indoor swimming pool and a fitness studio.
facts.excerpt: guests have access to Chuan Body + Soul spa and wellness sanctuary. It features a 16-metre indoor swimming pool, a fully equipped fitness studio

facts.text: Babysitting and childcare can be arranged through guest services.
facts.excerpt: babysitting and childcare services can be arranged through our guest services team.

facts.text: Dogs weighing 12kg or under can stay for a fee of 100 pounds per stay.
facts.excerpt: Dogs weighing 12kg or under are invited to stay for a fee of £100 per stay.

facts.text: The hotel has a cookery school, Sauce by The Langham.
facts.excerpt: SAUCE BY THE LANGHAM COOKERY SCHOOL

facts.text: The BBC building is across the street from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: The BBC building is across the street

facts.text: The room service menu is pricey.
facts.excerpt: The extensive room service menu is pricey

facts.text: The hotel holds Two Michelin Keys for 2025.
Conde Nast Traveler lists the hotel in its Readers' Choice Awards for 2026.
The hotel calls itself the birthplace of afternoon tea.
